Backend engineering from first request to production · check

Know Release and recover a first version already?

One question for each of the 2 puzzles in this module. A right answer marks that puzzle as passed, so you can jump ahead. A wrong one tells you which puzzle to start with. Nothing is sent anywhere: it's saved in this browser.

Puzzle 3: Where does the data live during a release?

The new service is ready but lists no bookmarks. What do you compare first?

Not quite. The service itself returned an empty list. Learn it in puzzle 3 →

Right. A named volume gives replacement containers access to the same stored data.

Puzzle 4: Alive, ready, or serving the wrong thing?

The read probe succeeds after recovery. What should you verify next?

Not quite. A running process can still fail to write. Learn it in puzzle 4 →

Right. A process can answer a simple probe while its storage path fails.
